title: 1967 Float for Humdingers in Potato Blossom Festival
description: In 1967, the Sisters of Hartland from Edward Laskey Temple No. 29 included a talented group of performers known as “The Humdingers.” In addition to entertaining, The Humdingers compiled a cookbook of time-tested traditional recipes. They are pictured riding a float in the Hartland Potato Festival parade.
